name: AMO Residence
label: Private condominium
top: Year only: expected 2026, as reported by Stacked Homes. We could not confirm a date on an official page.
intro: AMO Residence is a condominium of about 372 homes on Ang Mo Kio Rise, reported to be close to completion in 2026. Ang Mo Kio is a mature town, and many buyers are upgraders from nearby HDB flats. Below: key facts, what owners usually change, a defects check and how to plan your AMO Residence renovation.
whatsapp_text: Hi Maison, I'm collecting keys at AMO Residence and would like to discuss the renovation.

sections.heading: What to know about AMO Residence
sections.text:
Upgraders often bring furniture from their HDB flat, and condo rooms are shaped differently. Before buying anything new, measure what you are bringing and plan the built-ins around the pieces you want to keep.

Moving from HDB to a condo also changes the rules: renovation approval comes from the management, and the hours and deposits are set by the condo's by-laws. The developer's defects period is your chance to get things fixed before renovation starts.

sections.heading: What owners usually change
bullets: Built-ins planned around furniture you are bringing from your current home.
Wardrobe internals and an entrance cabinet.
A study corner or home office.
Lighting upgrades in the living and dining areas.
Curtains and blinds for every window.

timeline_note: Most new condo renovations take about 4 to 8 weeks from keys to move-in.

faq.q: When will AMO Residence be completed?
faq.a: Stacked Homes reported an expected TOP in 2026. We could not confirm this on an official page, so check your developer's notice.

faq.q: I'm moving from an HDB flat. What changes?
faq.a: Approval comes from the condo's management, not HDB, and working hours are set by its by-laws. Check the developer's defects process too.

faq.q: Should I keep my old furniture?
faq.a: Keep the pieces that fit. Measure them against the new floor plan before designing the built-ins, so everything works together.
